what: Semrush reports etsy.com desktop traffic sources in February 2026: direct traffic accounts for 49.52% of visits, followed by google.com at 20.25%.
verbatim_snippet: "On etsy.com, visitors mainly come from Direct (49.52% of traffic), followed by google.com (20.25%). In most cases, after visiting etsy.com, users go to google.com and etsystatic.com."
notes: Semrush page not directly fetched; captured from search snippet. Semrush reports lower direct traffic share (49.52%) versus SimilarWeb (59.01%), reflecting methodological differences.
